release.body:
**Bitcoin Commons BLVM** — Bitcoin node CLI.

> [!NOTE]
> Verify your download against `checksums.sha256` before running.

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Linux x86_64** (binary) | `blvm-0.1.65-linux-x86_64` | Default `cargo build --release` feature set |
| **Linux aarch64** (binary) | `blvm-0.1.65-linux-aarch64` | Raspberry Pi 4/5 (64-bit OS); same features as Linux x86_64 |
| **Linux x86_64** (tarball) | `blvm-v0.1.65-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | `blvm` + governance CLIs (+ checksum file inside) |
| **Linux aarch64** (tarball) | `blvm-v0.1.65-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | `blvm` for 64-bit ARM Linux (+ checksum file inside) |
| **Linux x86_64** (Arch / pacman) | `blvm-0.1.65-x86_64.pkg.tar.gz` | `pacman -U` |
| **Linux x86_64** (Debian/Ubuntu) | `blvm_0.1.65_amd64.deb` | `cargo deb` (matches standalone binary) |
| **Linux x86_64** (RHEL/Fedora) | `blvm-0.1.65-1.x86_64.rpm` | `cargo generate-rpm` |
| **Windows x86_64** | `blvm-0.1.65-windows-x86_64.exe` | Linux defaults minus Unix-only nix/libc |
| **Windows x86_64** (zip) | `blvm-v0.1.65-windows-x86_64.zip` | Same as .exe in archive form |
| **Checksums** | `checksums.sha256`, `SHA256SUMS-blvm-*`, `SHA256SUMS-linux-packages.txt` | Verify downloads |

## Verify

```bash
sha256sum -c checksums.sha256
```

## Install

**Linux (single binary):**
```bash
curl -LO https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/releases/download/v0.1.65/blvm-0.1.65-linux-x86_64
curl -LO https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/releases/download/v0.1.65/checksums.sha256
sha256sum -c checksums.sha256
chmod +x blvm-0.1.65-linux-x86_64
sudo mv blvm-0.1.65-linux-x86_64 /usr/local/bin/blvm
```

**Linux aarch64 (Raspberry Pi 4/5, 64-bit OS):**
```bash
curl -LO https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/releases/download/v0.1.65/blvm-0.1.65-linux-aarch64
curl -LO https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/releases/download/v0.1.65/checksums.sha256
sha256sum -c checksums.sha256
chmod +x blvm-0.1.65-linux-aarch64
sudo mv blvm-0.1.65-linux-aarch64 /usr/local/bin/blvm
```

**Linux (tarball):**
```bash
curl -LO https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/releases/download/v0.1.65/blvm-v0.1.65-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
tar -xzf blvm-v0.1.65-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
sudo mv blvm /usr/local/bin/
```

**Linux aarch64 (tarball, Raspberry Pi 4/5):**
```bash
curl -LO https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/releases/download/v0.1.65/blvm-v0.1.65-linux-aarch64.tar.gz
tar -xzf blvm-v0.1.65-linux-aarch64.tar.gz
sudo mv blvm /usr/local/bin/
```

**Debian/Ubuntu:**
```bash
curl -LO https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/releases/download/v0.1.65/blvm_0.1.65_amd64.deb
sudo dpkg -i blvm_0.1.65_amd64.deb
```

**RHEL/Fedora:**
```bash
curl -LO https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/releases/download/v0.1.65/blvm-0.1.65-1.x86_64.rpm
sudo rpm -i blvm-0.1.65-1.x86_64.rpm
```

**Windows:** Download `blvm-0.1.65-windows-x86_64.exe`, verify checksum, and run from a terminal.

## Linked crates

The binary linked these crates.io versions: consensus `0.1.67`, protocol `0.1.35`, node `0.1.75`, sdk `0.1.19`.

## Changes

See [commit history](https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/compare/d3d50ab19f0b727a828e0b57b32a522c5c8ac471...19da7201787402cc0f8c2a7ff3d677db5c29108b)

page.title: Install blvm
page.lead: Pre-built binaries and Linux packages from GitHub Releases, with checksums.sha256 on every release. Verify before running.

packages.label: Debian / Ubuntu
packages.description: Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 11+, and any dpkg-based distro.
packages.installCmd:
sudo dpkg -i blvm_0.1.65_amd64.deb
sudo apt-get install -f    # pull in any missing deps
packages.verify:
# Run in the folder where you saved blvm_0.1.65_amd64.deb
curl -LO https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/releases/download/v0.1.65/checksums.sha256
grep 'blvm_0.1.65_amd64.deb' checksums.sha256 | sha256sum --check

packages.label: Fedora / RHEL
packages.description: Fedora 38+, RHEL 9, CentOS Stream 9, and RPM-based distros.
packages.installCmd:
sudo rpm -i blvm-0.1.65-1.x86_64.rpm
# or via dnf:
sudo dnf install ./blvm-0.1.65-1.x86_64.rpm
packages.verify:
# Run in the folder where you saved blvm-0.1.65-1.x86_64.rpm
curl -LO https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/releases/download/v0.1.65/checksums.sha256

packages.label: Windows
packages.description: Portable Windows 10 / 11 build (64-bit). Download above, verify the checksum, then run the .exe from PowerShell.
packages.verify:
# PowerShell — same folder as blvm-0.1.65-windows-x86_64.exe
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/releases/download/v0.1.65/checksums.sha256' -OutFile checksums.sha256
$expected = ((Get-Content checksums.sha256 | Select-String -SimpleMatch 'blvm-0.1.65-windows-x86_64.exe').Line -split '\s+')[0]
$actual = (Get-FileHash blvm-0.1.65-windows-x86_64.exe -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
if ($expected.ToUpper() -eq $actual) { 'Checksum OK' } else { throw 'Checksum MISMATCH' }
